request: Analyze GSE219100, GSE218103 and GSE219099 for PMID 36620222 (Extracellular vesicle characteristics and microRNA content in cerebral palsy and typically developed individuals at rest and in response to aerobic exercise.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: small RNA-seq of plasma extracellular-vesicle RNA (miRBase v22, featureCounts raw counts)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of one acute aerobic exercise bout (45 min cycling in TD, 45 min Frame Running in CP) on EV microRNA cargo: 30 min post vs pre within TD EX and within CP EX; secondary (associational) CP vs TD at baseline and post-exercise
final.sample_inclusion: Only TD EX (n=10) and CP EX (n=9) participants were sequenced; pre and post samples pooled to N=3 pools per timepoint per group (TD: 2 pools of 3 men, 1 pool of 4 women; CP: 3 pools by GMFCS II/III/IV) (S2.6.p1). TD CON participants (no-exercise controls) were NOT sequenced.
final.repeated_measure_unit: pool of participants; the same pools are sampled pre and post, but which GEO pool index corresponds across timepoints is not documented
planned_contrasts: TD post vs pre (S3.3.p1 'Exercise did not affect EV cargo in any of the groups', Supp Fig S2; paper: 0 DE miRNAs)
CP post vs pre (S3.3.p1, S4.p7; paper: 0 DE miRNAs)
CP vs TD at baseline (S3.3.p1, FIG2A/B: miR-486 up; let-7a, let-7b, let-7e down)
CP vs TD post-exercise (S3.3.p1, FIG2C/D: miR-486, miR-100 up; miR-877, miR-4433 down)
final.normalization: DESeq2 size factors; miRNAs with < 10 counts removed (S2.9.p2)
final.paper_method: DESeq2 in R 3.6.2, model with genotype (TD/CP) and activity (EX/CON = pre/post); no pool/pairing term stated (S2.9.p2)
final.paper_results: No exercise effect on EV miRNA cargo in any group (S3.3.p1, S4.p7)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.6.p1 describes the pooling (N=3 per timepoint per group for TD EX and CP EX) and names GSE219100. S2.9.p2 gives DESeq2 on raw featureCounts counts, <10-count filter, genotype + activity model, BH-adjusted p < 0.05 with no fold-change rule. S3.3.p1/S4.p7 state exercise did not change EV miRNA cargo; FIG2 gives the CP vs TD miRNAs. The C2C12 miR-486 mimic experiment (S2.8.p1, GSE219099) is a mechanistic follow-up, not an exercise contrast.

So CON -> pre, EX -> post.

design.reasoning: The exercise estimand is the within-genotype time effect (post vs pre), which the paper reports as null (S3.3.p1, S4.p7). The paper's model includes genotype and activity (S2.9.p2) and reports between-genotype comparisons at each time (FIG2), so one model over the four geno x time cells with the four pairwise contrasts reproduces it. CP vs TD is a cross-sectional comparison (associational), not an exercise effect. n = 3 pools per cell.

covariates.name: pool (repeated pre/post)
covariates.disposition: excluded: the pre and post samples come from the same participant pools, but GEO does not document which pre pool matches which post pool (titles are only 'control 1..3' / 'exercise 1..3'; no sex/GMFCS label per pool) and the profiles show no index correspondence (pre/post log-CPM correlations do not peak on the diagonal); the paper's DESeq2 model has no pool term (S2.9.p2). Ignoring positive within-pool correlation makes the post-vs-pre test conservative, not anti-conservative.

covariance.reasoning: The paper's model (S2.9.p2) has genotype and activity only. A pool blocking term would be preferable, but the cross-timepoint pool mapping is not identifiable from GEO, and guessing it by index would risk a wrong subject mapping. The unpaired fit follows the paper and is conservative for the exercise contrasts; this is recorded as a caveat.

method.reasoning: Raw integer counts support DESeq2, which is the paper's method (S2.9.p2).

threshold.reasoning: S2.9.p2: 'statistically significant at an adjusted p < 0.05 (FDR: Benjamini-Hochberg)'; no fold-change rule. Raw p < 0.05 is reported only as a labelled audit count.

caveats: Pre and post samples are the same participant pools; pool correspondence is undocumented, so the model treats them as independent (as the paper's model does). The exercise tests are conservative.
Each cell has only 3 pools of 3-4 participants; library sizes are small (10k-285k miRNA reads; CPE2 has ~10k).
CP vs TD contrasts are associational (cross-sectional genotype difference), not exercise effects.
Post-exercise CP vs TD: miR-100-5p (up), miR-877-5p and miR-4433b-5p (down) match the paper's direction but have padj 0.056-0.067, just above the paper's FDR 0.05.

study.reasoning: Method, model, filter and threshold follow S2.9.p2; the pool-pairing limitation is shared with the paper. Paper counts: 0 exercise-responsive miRNAs in TD and CP (S3.3.p1, S4.p7); CP vs TD counts are the miRNAs the paper names (ABS.p1, S3.3.p1: 4 at baseline - miR-486 up, let-7a/b/e down; 4 post - miR-486, miR-100 up, miR-877, miR-4433(b) down); the complete lists are in Supplementary Table S1, which is not available here. The 5th suitability comparison geno_time_CP_post_vs_TD_pre is the geno x time interaction (difference in exercise response CP vs TD), run as exploratory; the paper does not report it.
